input.encoding: one input byte per integer in original file order

contract.repeat_behavior: The source overwrites the decoded buffer on each pass and prints the final decoded size; each ABI call returns the decoded bytes once, and the suite repeats calls 100 times per sample.
contract.maximum_output_bound: For inputs of at most 4,096 bytes in this format, 65 full 45-byte lines plus one 24-byte line fit and decode to 2,949 bytes.
contract.source_fixture_profile: First 65 complete data lines from the pinned input-file, followed by the zero-length line and end marker.
